title: Location Business News: NextNav Disputes SIA Claims Over 5G PNT Network in California
summary: Location Business News: NextNav Disputes SIA Claims Over 5G PNT Network in California
body_markdown:
NextNav is responding to claims from the Security Industry Association (SIA) regarding our operational 5G PNT network in Santa Clara County. In a recent article from Location Business News, Renee Gregory, NextNav’s senior vice president of regulatory and government affairs, addresses inaccuracies in SIA’s latest FCC filing and explains why the underlying comparisons are misleading.


**Read the full article on[Location Business News](https://locationbusinessnews.com/nextnav-disputes-sia-claims-over-5g-pnt-network-in-california#google_vignette)** .
